bayts.text: Truly I have taken refuge with God, the Helper (Al-Muʿīn), from all harm and from every accursed one,
turning my aspiration to my Lord, the Most High, hoping that He will give me to drink of a flowing spring,
holding fast to the Book as a blind man holds the hand of the clear-sighted guide who helps him.
It is my might, my elevation and my treasures, and through it I hope for the submission of the refractory.
Whoever through it seeks to tame something hard and stubborn, it leads it to him obedient, with docility.
It is my pride, my firm handhold and my companion, together with the ḥadīth of the possessor of distinctions, the firmly established (Muḥammad):
Aḥmad, the greatest praiser among praisers, Aḥmad, my succour: and toward my Lord, through this and those, is my reliance.
O my God, pour upon him blessing and peace, together with his Family and the people of certainty,
among the Companions, who devoted themselves wholly to a Guardian (Al-Wakīl) Who guided them with the light of the truth of certainty.
Lord, grant me uprightness and zeal in what pleases You, and erase from me what lies buried (within me).
O my God, O You in Whom is my trust, loosen my fetter by taming the people of the ships.
Hasten the (spiritual) opening and bestow outpourings that put to shame the downpour of laden clouds.
Lord, undo my captivity and my pledge, for by my sins I am shackled in prisons.
Lord, I am a servant of many disobediences, and disobediences are ḥāʾ, bāʾ and sīn (ḥabs, prison).
Train me, Lord, raise me, set my state aright; purify for me the nūn before fāʾ and sīn (nafs, the soul).
Adorn me, Lord, adorn me with distinctions, like shīn before mīm and sīn (shams, the sun).
Answer my supplication for me with what surpasses my expectation, and with what surpasses, Lord, every conjecture.
Grant me unveiling, (making me) endowed with sciences and deeds, and erase from me what was like madness.
Grant me today, O my God, firmness; purify my breast for me, without the rusts (of the heart).
Pardon me, bear in my place the rights (I owe) to creatures, and settle my debts for me.
And grant me to be a servant of the Mighty Book at every time.
Grant me today to take my religion from it, standing (in prayer), reciting without faults of pronunciation.
Unveil its secrets to me and grant me its guidance, and the guidance of the Sunna of the Trustworthy, the firmly established (Muḥammad).
Bless him unceasingly, Lord, and grant him peace, and through him make my repose in You endure.
And make recitation and night prayer endure for me in the nights, and ever raise my state.
By my imām, my refuge and my chief, and through him take charge for ever of my provision.
And grant me to follow in his footsteps in belief, and in word as in deed, throughout the time of my sojourn (here below).
And through him drive the enemies away from me, and ever guard my inner self from them.
O Rescuer Who helps every poor one, loosen the fetter of him who has become like a hostage.
Lord, by the Chosen One, the Last to Come, my beloved and my physician against the incurable, humiliating disease,
